about.title: Code is just a means.
about.body: I don't come from code, and maybe that's my thing. Three years ago, I had a head full of ideas and wanted to make them exist. Development was the most direct path, so I learned it. Since then, the way I work has shifted: I drive AI as much as I code, and I spend more time imagining and testing than writing lines. What drives me is everything code and AI make possible when you have ideas — and the will to make them real.
